title: harnesswatch
description: Security audit toolkit for AI coding-agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Copilot CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity and 50+ more): static audits of harness configuration, MCP declarations, instruction files, secret residue, supply chain and CI, with SARIF output; a black-box behavioural probe (observe); and an inert canary prompt-injection benchmark. Companion software to the paper "The Harness Is the Attack Surface: A Security Analysis of AI Coding-Agent Harnesses (2025-2026)" (https://thanatchon36.github.io/harnesswatch/paper/).
